BLE Detail
—
R32 rotates the active QR/token every 2 minutes while preserving the 7:00 AM / 7:00 PM day-night shift windows. Expired tokens are identified as EXPIRED QR FLAG; mismatches are QR MISMATCH RED FLAG; repeated token use can be marked REPLAY FLAG. BLE is a proximity security layer for a nearby BLE-advertising device/beacon. Biometric remains the primary attendance source and Guard remains the manual attendance authorizer.
